BiblicalUsage: ʼEthbaʻal was a king of Sidon, the father of Jezebel. The name occurs once, in 1 Kings. The fuller story lives on the People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I take ʼEthbaʻal as it stands: a real name, in a real record. That is enough reason to slow down and notice the name rather than skip it.
